article_content: 'Yan Najeriya ta cikar da al'amuran cewar wayar da kan al'umma a gari da tabbatar da adalci (EVMs). An dade an kuka a kan rashin sahihancin zabbubuka, hakan ya sa kula su 'yan siyasar da suka yi nasara a zabubbukan. Misali, President Umar Musa Yar'Adua ya fada a shekara 2007, ya tabbatar da EVMs a shugabancin kasar, inda ya kuma lashi takobin yin duk mai yiwuwa. Domin cika wannan, a 2007, shugaba Yar'Adua ya kafa wani kwamiti gyaran EVMs. Mambobin kwamiti sun fito ne, kuma sun mikawa gwamnati rahoton a 2008. Bayan rasuwar Yar'Adua, President Goodluck Jonathan ya ci gaba da hanyoyin yi nasara a zabubbuka, inda a 2010, ya nada Attahiru Jega a matsayin shugaban INEC. Farfesa Jega ya yi yinkurin kawo sauye-sauye a 2011, shigo da 'yan bautar kasa. Amma dai EVMs ma su zabe ta 'card reader' a 2015, ko kuma har da kasashen duniya. Misali, a Ghana 2012, EVMs ya taimake duk wani yunkurin magudi. A Najeriya, masu ganin rashin dacewar EVMs sun tafka mahawara. Hukumar Najeriya ta ce ta ji ta gani ta shirya amfani da EVMs. A 2015, su sun gudanar da zaben gwajin a mazabu 12 daga jahohi 12. Matsaloli sun hada da rashin karbar yatsun masu zabe sakamakon kaushin yatsu. Hukumar zabe ta kasa ta yi amfani da na'urar tantance masu zabe a 2015, ta hanyoyi kamar haka: Cewar an kada kuri'u kimanin 29,432,083 (43.65%). Don haka, hukumar zabe ta ce ta ji ta gani ta kara inganta hanyoyin amfani da EVMs a 2019, to akwai kyakkyawan zaton cewar zaben zai zama karbabbe ga 'yan Najeriya.
translated_content: Nigeria has been exploring the use of electronic voting machines (EVMs) to enhance election credibility and address controversies. For instance, President Umar Musa Yar'Adua launched a pilot project in 2007 to boost electoral transparency. Subsequently, he formed a committee in 2007 to introduce EVMs, which successfully completed its task and reported in 2008. Post Yar'Adua's passing, President Goodluck Jonathan continued electoral reforms, appointing Attahiru Jega as INEC chairman in 2010. Prof. Jega quickly implemented improvements, including biometric voter registration in 2011. However, EVMs faced challenges, especially with the 'card reader' in 2015, affecting voter turnout. Despite these hurdles, Nigeria's journey mirrors global trends. Ghana, for example, successfully used EVMs in 2012. Nigerian experts recognize EVMs' potential benefits. In 2015, the electoral commission managed 12 out of 12 state elections efficiently. They aim to improve EVM usage in 2019 through enhanced voter education. The 2015 voter turnout was 43.65%, highlighting the need for further improvement in future elections.

Chineme Martins, mai shekara 23, ya mutu ne bayan ya fadi a fili a gasar lig ta Najeriya wata daya da ya gabatar da wasan wasa a cikin filin wasa. Cikin watan Disamban 2018, a filin wasa da ke Lafiya, a jihar Nasarawa, aka buga wasan sada zumunta tsakanin Nasarawa United da FC Abuja.

Dominic Dukudod ya fadi a cikin fili, an kuma yi kokarin ceto ransa amma abin ya ce tura. Bayan da Dukudod wanda ake cewa yana fama da ciwon zuciya ya mutu a hanyar kai shi asibiti. Duk da kokarin ceto ransa da aka yi a cikin filin wasa, babu wanda zai ce maka ga wata na'urar da aka yi amfani da ita wajen tura mota.

Nasarawa United wadda ta ke cikin 'yan kasan teburi za ta buga wasa a gida da Katsina United ranar 8 ga watan Maris wata daya tsakani. Dan wasan tsakiya na Nasarawa United, Chineme Martins, na fatan yin bajinta a karawar, hakan ne ya sa ya dauki hoton teburin gasar Firimiyar ya aikewa dan uwansa tare da sakon cewar, "Kalli matakin da muke a kasan teburi za mu kara yin sama bayan wasa da Katsina." 

A makonnin baya Nasarawa ta samu sakamako mai kyau da ya sa ta bar cikin 'yan kasan teburi. Wannan karon suna bukatar cin wasan domin ci gaba da zama a gasar a badi. A wasa na gaba da Nasarawa United za ta buga sai ga shi ta tanadi motar kai marasa lafiya asibiti ba guda daya ba har uku a cikin fili.

Motar daukar marar lafiya a babban filin wasa da ke garin Lafiya ta kasa tashi ranar 8 Maris. Likitan kungiyar Nasarawa United ya fada cewar da 'yan wasa da likitoci da 'yan kallo duk sun garzaya don cetar rai. To amma yin hakan, karya doka ne domin cewa aka yi likitoci ko kuma kwararrun lafiya aka amince su duba dan wasa a cikin fili.

Bayan da babu na'urar da ya kamata a fili da kwarrarrun lafiya da ya kamata su duba dan wasa ga motar kai marasa lafiya asibiti taki tashi. Dalilin da ya sa kenan 'yan kallo suka shiga fili, wasu ma suka taimaka wajen tura mota.

Shugaban hukumar kwolon kafar jihar Nasarawa ya fadi na shi labarin na daban. An diba lafiyar Chineme Martins Nasarawa United kafin soma kaka. Ranar Laraba aka cika wata daya da Chineme ya mutu, bayan da ake ta jiran hukumar kwolon kafar kasar NFF ta fitar da dalilin da ya sa dan wasan ya mutu da hanyoyin da ya kamata a bi nan gaba don kiyaye faruwar hakan.

NFF ta sanar da dokar cewar ba za a fara wasa ba har sai an tanadi dukkan kayayyakin duba marar lafiya da taimakon gaggawa da ma'aikatan lafiya. Sai kwamishinan wasa da hukumar kwolon kafar jiha sun tabbatar komai na aiki kan a fara wasa. An ci tarar Nasarawa United sama da dala 15,000, bayan da ta karya dokoki da dama. Tun daga gazawa wajen samar da kayayyakin aiki da ma'aikatan lafiya da suka kamata a lokacin, da kuma barin mutane da dama suka shiga fili a lokacin cetar rai da amfani da motar daukar marasa lafiya wadda ta kasance a lalace.

Motocin daukar marar lafiya uku aka gani bayan dan wasa ya mutu a fili.
